digest.component_or_area: pytest test infrastructure / temporary fixture management
propositions: Nested pytest child processes without explicit --basetemp allocate and register cleanup against the user-global numbered temp root, causing unrelated cleanup-eligible directories to be deleted when the child session finishes.

Two test files (test_engine_dir.py and test_scripts_import_convention.py) execute nested pytest children under repository autouse fixtures without passing parent-owned tmp_path as --basetemp, triggering unintended cleanup of shared numbered temp roots.

Existing safe patterns (test_external_isolation.py, _store_isolation.py) and pytester-managed launches already pass parent-owned basetemp to children; only two direct subprocess launchers remain unsafe.
The repair assigns each executing nested child a unique basetemp derived from the parent's tmp_path fixture, preventing access to the shared numbered root and preserving cleanup isolation.
